Application Data.NAME: Innovative Cable Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Innovative Cable Solutions, Inc. provides a range of cable and telecommunications services, including the installation and maintenance of high-speed internet, cable television services, and digital phone systems. Our operations primarily focus on delivering reliable connectivity and entertainment solutions for residential and commercial clients. We engage in limited sales of ancillary products, such as cable modems and installation kits, ensuring that these sales constitute less than 30% of our gross revenue. Furthermore, we do not engage in catering operations or performance entertainment; our services are strictly confined to telecommunications with no live events or high-profile entertainment involved. Our commitment to adhering to the underwriting guidelines ensures a safe and compliant operational framework for our business.
